name: ios-sim
description: Control an iOS Simulator running on a Mac from any Linux machine.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/protocol build && bun run --cwd packages/darwin-compat build && bun run --cwd apps/host build && bun run --cwd apps/cli build && bun run --cwd apps/native build
scripts.dev:docs: bun run architecture:build && bun run --cwd docs-site start
scripts.docs:build: bun run architecture:build && bun run --cwd docs-site build
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run docs:build
